잠언-20-1.title: 잠언 20장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-1.exegesis: 29. Their punishment is sure, fixed, and ready (compare Pr 3:34 ; 10:13 ).
잠언-20-1.theologicalNote: 29. Their punishment is sure, fixed, and ready (compare Pr 3:34 ; 10:13 ).

잠언-20-2.title: 잠언 20장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 20 Pr 20:1-30 . 1. mocker-- scorner. Such men are made by wine. strong drink-- made by spicing wine (compare Is 5:11 , 22 ); and it may include wine. raging-- or boisterous as a drunkard. deceived-- literally, "erring," or reeling.
잠언-20-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 20 Pr 20:1-30 . 1. mocker-- scorner. Such men are made by wine. strong drink-- made by spicing wine (compare Is 5:11 , 22 ); and it may include wine. raging-- or boisterous as a drunkard. deceived-- literally, "erring," or reeling.

잠언-20-3.title: 잠언 20장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-3.exegesis: 2. (Compare Pr 19:12 ). Men who resist authority injure themselves ( Ro 13:2 ).
잠언-20-3.theologicalNote: 2. (Compare Pr 19:12 ). Men who resist authority injure themselves ( Ro 13:2 ).

잠언-20-4.title: 잠언 20장 4절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-4.exegesis: 3. to cease from strife-- or, better, "to dwell from or without strife," denoting the habit of life. fool ... meddling-- ( Pr 17:14 ).
잠언-20-4.theologicalNote: 3. to cease from strife-- or, better, "to dwell from or without strife," denoting the habit of life. fool ... meddling-- ( Pr 17:14 ).

잠언-20-5.title: 잠언 20장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-5.exegesis: 4. shall ... beg-- literally, "ask" (in this sense, Psa 109:10 ).
잠언-20-5.theologicalNote: 4. shall ... beg-- literally, "ask" (in this sense, Psa 109:10 ).

잠언-20-6.title: 잠언 20장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-6.exegesis: 5. Counsel ... water-- that is, deeply hidden ( Pr 18:4 ; Psa 13:2 ). The wise can discern well.
잠언-20-6.theologicalNote: 5. Counsel ... water-- that is, deeply hidden ( Pr 18:4 ; Psa 13:2 ). The wise can discern well.

잠언-20-7.title: 잠언 20장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-7.exegesis: 6. Boasters are unreliable. goodness-- or, "kind disposition."
잠언-20-7.theologicalNote: 6. Boasters are unreliable. goodness-- or, "kind disposition."

잠언-20-8.title: 잠언 20장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-8.exegesis: 7. The conduct of good men proclaims their sound principles. God's covenant and their good example secure blessing to their children ( Pr 4:26 ; Psa 112:1 , 2).
잠언-20-8.theologicalNote: 7. The conduct of good men proclaims their sound principles. God's covenant and their good example secure blessing to their children ( Pr 4:26 ; Psa 112:1 , 2).

잠언-20-9.title: 잠언 20장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-9.exegesis: 8. As in Pr 14:35 ; 16:10 , 15 , this is the character of a good king, not of all kings.
잠언-20-9.theologicalNote: 8. As in Pr 14:35 ; 16:10 , 15 , this is the character of a good king, not of all kings.

잠언-20-10.title: 잠언 20장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-10.exegesis: 9. The interrogation in the affirmative strengthens the implied negation (compare Job 15:14 ; Ec 7:20 ).
잠언-20-10.theologicalNote: 9. The interrogation in the affirmative strengthens the implied negation (compare Job 15:14 ; Ec 7:20 ).

잠언-20-11.title: 잠언 20장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-11.exegesis: 10. Various measures, implying that some are wrong (compare Pr 11:1 ; 16:11 ).
잠언-20-11.theologicalNote: 10. Various measures, implying that some are wrong (compare Pr 11:1 ; 16:11 ).

잠언-20-12.title: 잠언 20장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-12.exegesis: 11. The conduct of children even is the best test of principle (compare Mt 7:16 ).
잠언-20-12.theologicalNote: 11. The conduct of children even is the best test of principle (compare Mt 7:16 ).

잠언-20-13.title: 잠언 20장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-13.exegesis: 12. Hence, of course, God will know all you do ( Psa 94:9 ).
잠언-20-13.theologicalNote: 12. Hence, of course, God will know all you do ( Psa 94:9 ).

잠언-20-14.title: 잠언 20장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-14.exegesis: 13. Activity and diligence contrasted with sloth ( Pr 6:9 ; 10:11 ). lest ... poverty-- literally, "be deprived of inheritance."
잠언-20-14.theologicalNote: 13. Activity and diligence contrasted with sloth ( Pr 6:9 ; 10:11 ). lest ... poverty-- literally, "be deprived of inheritance."

잠언-20-15.title: 잠언 20장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-15.exegesis: 14. when ... his way-- implying that he goes about boasting of his bargains.
잠언-20-15.theologicalNote: 14. when ... his way-- implying that he goes about boasting of his bargains.

잠언-20-16.title: 잠언 20장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-16.exegesis: 15. The contrast denotes the greater value of knowledge (compare Pr 3:14-16 ).
잠언-20-16.theologicalNote: 15. The contrast denotes the greater value of knowledge (compare Pr 3:14-16 ).

잠언-20-17.title: 잠언 20장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-17.exegesis: 16. Take his garment-- implies severe exaction, justified by the surety's rashness. a strange woman-- by some readings "strangers," but the former here, and in Pr 27:13 , is allowable, and strengthens the sense. The debauchee is less reliable than the merely careless.
잠언-20-17.theologicalNote: 16. Take his garment-- implies severe exaction, justified by the surety's rashness. a strange woman-- by some readings "strangers," but the former here, and in Pr 27:13 , is allowable, and strengthens the sense. The debauchee is less reliable than the merely careless.

잠언-20-18.title: 잠언 20장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-18.exegesis: 17. Bread ... sweet-- either as unlawfully ( Pr 9:17 ) or easily obtained. mouth ... gravel-- well expresses the pain and grief given at last.
잠언-20-18.theologicalNote: 17. Bread ... sweet-- either as unlawfully ( Pr 9:17 ) or easily obtained. mouth ... gravel-- well expresses the pain and grief given at last.

잠언-20-19.title: 잠언 20장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-19.exegesis: 18. (Compare Pr 15:22 ). Be careful and considerate in important plans.
잠언-20-19.theologicalNote: 18. (Compare Pr 15:22 ). Be careful and considerate in important plans.

잠언-20-20.title: 잠언 20장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-20.exegesis: 19. Those who love to tell news will hardly keep secrets. flattereth ... lips-- (compare Margin; Pr 1:10 ). meddle ... him-- literally, "join," or "associate with."
잠언-20-20.theologicalNote: 19. Those who love to tell news will hardly keep secrets. flattereth ... lips-- (compare Margin; Pr 1:10 ). meddle ... him-- literally, "join," or "associate with."

잠언-20-22.title: 잠언 20장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-22.exegesis: 21. gotten hastily-- contrary to God's providence ( Pr 28:20 ), implying its unjust or easy attainment; hence the man is punished, or spends freely what he got easily (compare Pr 20:17 ).
잠언-20-22.theologicalNote: 21. gotten hastily-- contrary to God's providence ( Pr 28:20 ), implying its unjust or easy attainment; hence the man is punished, or spends freely what he got easily (compare Pr 20:17 ).

잠언-20-25.title: 잠언 20장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-25.exegesis: 24. Man's goings-- literally, "Stately steppings of a strong man." a man-- any common man. understand-- or, "perceive."
잠언-20-25.theologicalNote: 24. Man's goings-- literally, "Stately steppings of a strong man." a man-- any common man. understand-- or, "perceive."

잠언-20-26.title: 잠언 20장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-26.exegesis: 25. devoureth ... holy-- or, better, "who rashly speaks promises," or "devotes what is holy," consecrating any thing. This suits better the last clause, which expresses a similar view of the results of rashly vowing.
잠언-20-26.theologicalNote: 25. devoureth ... holy-- or, better, "who rashly speaks promises," or "devotes what is holy," consecrating any thing. This suits better the last clause, which expresses a similar view of the results of rashly vowing.

잠언-20-27.title: 잠언 20장 27절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-27.exegesis: 26. (Compare Pr 20:8 ). bringeth ... over them-- The wheel was used for threshing grain. The figure denotes severity (compare Am 1:3 ).
잠언-20-27.theologicalNote: 26. (Compare Pr 20:8 ). bringeth ... over them-- The wheel was used for threshing grain. The figure denotes severity (compare Am 1:3 ).

잠언-20-28.title: 잠언 20장 28절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-28.exegesis: 27. The spirit ... Lord-- Men's minds are God's gifts, and thus able to search one another (compare Pr 20:5 ; Pr 18:8 , 17 ; 1Co 2:11 ).
잠언-20-28.theologicalNote: 27. The spirit ... Lord-- Men's minds are God's gifts, and thus able to search one another (compare Pr 20:5 ; Pr 18:8 , 17 ; 1Co 2:11 ).

잠언-20-30.title: 잠언 20장 30절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-20-30.exegesis: 29. The glory of young men ... the beauty of old men-- Each age has its peculiar excellence ( Pr 16:31 ).
잠언-20-30.theologicalNote: 29. The glory of young men ... the beauty of old men-- Each age has its peculiar excellence ( Pr 16:31 ).
